raw_text: China Digital Times has obtained screenshots of coordinated messaging directives from CCP propaganda departments instructing content creators to produce and disseminate anti-DPP material ahead of Taiwan's presidential election. The directives specifically mention deepfake video production quotas and hashtag amplification targets. Multiple Weibo accounts have been suspended after posting identical scripts attacking Lai Ching-te's cross-strait positions.
